sentences.text: No: for a floating-rate loan granted to an individual for a purpose other than business and sanctioned on or after 1 January 2026, a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges. [E8][R4]
The March 2026 sanction date falls within the scope of the 2025 Directions on loans sanctioned or renewed on or after 1 January 2026. [R3][E8]
The earlier 2014 floating-rate term-loan foreclosure-charge circular is no longer in force on 2026-11-23. [R2]
